EmailTemplate.subject: OrgPlus RealTime – Assistant not in Assistant location
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
If there is an assistant on an organization chart that is not in the assistant location, please follow the below steps:
Go into the Administration Tab. Click on the fields Tab. Click on the Hierarchy & Special Function Fields. Click the drop down and map the IsAssistant to the (Assistant Position).
Please let us know if we can be of further assistance. Thank you for allowing Insperity to serve you.
Thank you,
